body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2007') -- <Visual News> RCA presented ''EZ201'', its new easy-to-use pocket-size digital camcorder during CES 2007. It features 1.5-inch LCD SD card expansion slot. And it can be connected to TV directly while data can be stored easily via USB port. You don''t need separate software to install and it runs on two AA batteries.
Meanwhile, the company also presented ''memory maker'' enabling you to make DVD with the video recorded with the EZ201.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2007 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Niki Hwang, Alliyah Seo, Jun Lee, Daniel Sirh >
